items.title: Unit 8 · Story
items.scene: I see a boy in ___ boots.
items.prompt: Listen and choose the word.
items.spokenScene: I see a boy in blue boots.
items.storyText: It is Tuesday. I am at the zoo. I am looking for clues. I see a boy in blue boots. He has fruit. Oh no! The fruit is gone. I see a woman in a new suit. She has fruit, too. Oh no! The fruit is gone. I see an elephant with lots of food!
items.why: In “Clues at the Zoo”, you hear: I see a boy in blue boots. The missing word is “blue”.
items.hint: Listen to this sentence again. Look at the story picture.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 3, Unit 8, p.79 · Titi narration of the supplied textbook text
